feeds.title: International Family Nursing Association (IFNA) Blog
feeds.description: Membership of the Chapter is free and is open to any nurse, midwife or health visitor/public health nurse who is working in: practice, education or research, in the UK and Ireland, and who is interested in joining a growing community of family nurses Membership is also free and open to academics and researchers working in fields related to family nursing, as well as to patients, caregivers and family members interested in promoting family-focused care.

feeds.title: Happythreads Blog
feeds.description: Happythreads started in 2009 out of the frustration at the market of ill-fitting, traditional medical uniforms. It was the vision of co-founders Daniel Plewman and Abigail Moore to bring stylish, premium scrubs to the healthcare workers of Ireland and the UK. Now a leading supplier of healthcare uniforms in that market, their vision has come to life.
